title: Property Taxes
description: Taxes conditioned on ownership of property and measured by its value

title: General Sales and Gross Receipts Taxes
description: Sales taxes applicable to sales of goods and services generally

title: Alcoholic Beverages Selective Sales Tax
description: Selective sales and gross receipts taxes on alcoholic beverages

title: Motor Fuels Selective Sales Tax
description: Selective sales and gross receipts taxes on gasoline and diesel fuels

title: Public Utilities Selective Sales Tax
description: Selective taxes on gross receipts of public utility companies

title: Tobacco Products Selective Sales Tax
description: Selective sales taxes on cigarettes and other tobacco products

title: Insurance Premiums Selective Sales Tax
description: Taxes on gross insurance premiums received by insurance companies

title: Other Selective Sales and Gross Receipts Taxes
description: Amusements, admissions, pari-mutuels, meals, hotel occupancy taxes

title: Alcoholic Beverages License Taxes
description: Licenses for manufacturing, wholesaling, and retailing alcoholic beverages

title: Amusements License Taxes
description: License taxes on theaters, bowling alleys, race tracks, exhibitions

title: Corporation in General License Taxes
description: Franchise taxes and organization fees on business corporations

title: Motor Vehicles License Taxes
description: Registration and license fees on automobiles, trucks, trailers, buses

title: Motor Vehicle Operators License Taxes
description: Licenses for operating motor vehicles (driver licenses and permits)

title: Occupations and Businesses License Taxes
description: Licenses on specific professions, trades, businesses, and occupations

title: Individual Income Taxes
description: Taxes on net income of individuals, estates, and trusts

title: Corporation Net Income Taxes
description: Taxes on net income of corporations and unincorporated businesses

title: Death and Gift Taxes
description: Taxes on property transfers at death or by gift (estate, inheritance)

title: Documentary and Stock Transfer Taxes
description: Taxes on recording deeds, mortgages, real estate conveyances, stocks

title: Severance Taxes
description: Taxes on the extraction or severing of natural resources from soil/water

title: Intergovernmental Revenue from Federal Government
description: Direct grants, shared revenues, and payments in lieu of taxes from Federal government

title: Intergovernmental Revenue from State Government
description: State grants-in-aid, state shared taxes, and contingent payments to local governments

title: Intergovernmental Revenue from Local Governments
description: Transfers, shared revenues, and payments from other local governments

title: Education Current Charges
description: School lunch sales, athletic fees, book rentals, and tuition charges

title: Hospital Current Charges
description: Fees from patients and private insurance for public hospital services

title: Highways and Toll Current Charges
description: Toll roads, bridges, tunnels, ferries, and highway service fees

title: Sewerage Current Charges
description: Sewer service fees, sewer connection fees, effluent disposal charges

title: Solid Waste Management Current Charges
description: Garbage collection fees, commercial hauling fees, landfill tipping charges

title: Parks and Recreation Current Charges
description: Greens fees, admission to recreational facilities, camp fees, marina slips

title: Water Supply Utility Revenue
description: Revenue from retail and wholesale public drinking water sales

title: Electric Power Utility Revenue
description: Revenue from retail and wholesale electric power sales

title: Gas Supply Utility Revenue
description: Revenue from public natural gas utility distribution

title: Public Mass Transit Utility Revenue
description: Passenger fares, passes, and transit operating revenue

title: Short-Term Debt Outstanding
description: Interest-bearing tax anticipation notes, bond anticipation notes, warrants due <= 1 year

title: Long-Term Debt Outstanding - Full Faith and Credit
description: General obligation bonds secured by unconditional taxing power of government

title: Long-Term Debt Outstanding - Nonguaranteed / Revenue Debt
description: Revenue bonds secured solely by pledged enterprise revenues, special assessments, or specific taxes
